nodes.label: Settings and persisted onboarding
nodes.rationale: Saved onboarding state works across browsers. Steps persist incrementally, and settings unmarshal over defaults so earlier installations inherit new fields.

nodes.label: Transactional data reset and cross-tab reload
nodes.rationale: Discovering tables through sqlite_master makes reset include future tables automatically. Key deletion and data.reset accompany the database wipe, bringing open tabs back to onboarding.

nodes.label: Pure nudge calculation and server-clock firing window
nodes.rationale: A lastTick < at <= now window catches throttled intervals without replaying old nudges on reload. Clock jumps adjust the window, notification tags collapse duplicate tabs, and the model runs only when an event-end nudge is clicked.

nodes.label: Fixed day-strip window and moving now marker
nodes.rationale: A window anchored at now pins the marker to the left edge. A window covering day start, events, current time, and end-of-day permits the marker to move and keeps the end-of-day label inside the strip.
